notes: Cumulative Safety Tracker build. Preserves v2.11.65 controlled document-set annual/individual review controls and all prior pack/TBT/Manager features. Simplifies People & Access so Main Department is selected directly and is independent from Main Position, with optional additional Departments and Positions. Official HOD is tied to Main Department. Adds Operational Overseer as a separate multi-Department responsibility that does not replace the official HOD. Manager mode can work across all managed/overseen Departments or drill into one selected Department. New Safety users default to the Safety site from which they are created. Existing HOD/profile compatibility functions now use Main Department rather than deriving Department from Position. Database changes for v2.11.66 are already applied.
